bullets.title: Silicone Universal Lid
bullets.note: from Made In, a 2018 TIME magazine invention of the year.** For some reason, I lose pot lids. I have a motley crew of cookware, and half of them are missing covers. Perhaps it was my move from CA to TX, or perhaps it’s simply the fact that lids are easily confused with one another and a pain to store. Imagine my glee when I found a single gadget that gets rid of the headache: a one-size-fits-nearly-all silicone pot cover. Just get a few of them, and you’re set. Or put another way, no need to buy another set. Your ragtag gang of mismatched metal can now be a functional family again.

bullets.title: Newness
bullets.note: Polyamory? Off-menu sexual arrangements and relationship stress-testing? This movie has enough twists and turns to make anyone mutter, “Oh, God… don’t do it. Oh, no…,” and cover their eyes, peeking through split fingers. I watched this with a group of four, and each of us found the movie to be a rollercoaster of eroticism, masochism, deceit, brutal honesty, and—oddly enough—hope. It’s realistic enough to make nearly everyone uncomfortable at points, and that’s a good thing.

bullets.section: For a far lighter palate cleanser —
bullets.title: Big Mouth
bullets.note: This hilarious R/X-rated animated series was recommended to me countless times, and I finally caved. It’s great medicine if you’re taking shit too seriously, especially if you’ve given yourself an emotional Heimlich maneuver with _Newness_ (above). I suggest starting with Episode 1 of Season 1, titled “Ejaculation.” If that word somehow offends you, this may not be the show for you.
